720	That is very serious.	Isso é muito grave.
721	That is why "the children of Israel went up armed": they were armed with the bones of Yosef.	Por isso, "armados subiram os filhos de Israel": estavam armados com os ossos de Yosef.
722	And that ammunition was the strongest of all the weapons they took with them, because	E essa munição era a mais forte de todas as armas que levaram consigo, porque
723	the bones of Yosef are the merit through which the Yam Suf was split for them.	os ossos de Yosef são o mérito pelo qual o Yam Suf se abriu para eles.
724	May HaShem, blessed be He, grant us the merit to do His will as He wishes.	Que HaShem, bendito seja Ele, nos conceda o mérito de fazer a Sua vontade como Ele deseja.
725	Whoever wants USB books, they are with Aharon outside. May He decree good decrees for you, salvations and comforts.	Quem quiser livros em USB, estão com Aharon lá fora. Que decrete para vocês bons decretos, salvações e consolos.
